metadata.title: Investigate Missing Home Status Sync in COMA

blocks.content: The user reported that the home status change is visible in the source system but not yet reflected in COMA. The case is treated as a synchronization check with no direct data update yet.

items: Wait the normal COMA sync window.
Check the coma_status table again after 5–30 minutes.
If still unchanged, review the related tmf_resources row.
Escalate only if the sync never appears.

blocks.content: SELECT * FROM coma_status WHERE homeId IN ('GHI008800770001') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 10;
